name: ZT605
tagline: Sleek vertical heating with integrated log storage
description: The ZT605 is an elegant, tall-profile wood stove built from premium thick cast iron for exceptional structural integrity and rapid warmth. Designed with urban spaces in mind, its vertical footprint maximizes floor space while offering a large glass viewing window for a dramatic fire display. The unit features an open lower compartment for convenient log storage alongside dual flue options for flexible room layout adaptation.
features: Thick cast iron construction for reliable heat output and durability
Space-saving vertical design with built-in open log storage base
Large panoramic glass panel providing an unobstructed view of the flames
Dual configuration allowing for both top and rear flue connections
User-adjustable primary air control lever for precision combustion
